help.seoDescription: Learn the Markdown and advanced content blocks supported by PSRay trophy tips.
help.title: Markdown writing guide
help.lead: Write clear trophy guides with familiar Markdown and PSRay's collapsible, callout, step and spoiler blocks.

basic.title: Markdown basics
basic.description: These familiar forms work in every trophy tip.
basic.headingTocHint: Tips automatically generate a table of contents from H1–H4 headings. Follow the content hierarchy and do not use headings merely to enlarge text.
basic.heading: Headings (H1–H4)

images.title: Images
images.description: Images always appear as standalone blocks for readable guides and long-form posts. Add Pandoc attributes immediately after an image to set its size. Setting only width or height preserves its intrinsic ratio; setting both uses the requested dimensions. Values are pixels from 1 to 4096.

formatting.title: Text formatting
formatting.description: Select text in the editor, then apply a background highlight, colored underline, allow-listed text color or text size.
formatting.attributesDescription: Pandoc-style syntax keeps attributes for the same range in one attribute block. Nest only when the text ranges differ. Attribute order does not affect the result.

combined.title: Combine the same range
combined.description: When color, size and underline apply to the same text, keep the attributes together.

nested.title: Nest different ranges
nested.description: The outer size applies to all text while the inner color applies only to part of it.

avoid.title: Repeat nesting for one range
avoid.description: This parses correctly but is verbose; use a single attribute block instead.

advanced.title: Advanced blocks
advanced.description: Start a block with ::: and finish it with another ::: line.

examples.detailsBody: Break the crate on the right after passing through the castle gate to obtain the **collectible**.
examples.infoBody: This challenge becomes available after **Chapter 3** and has a recommended level of 20.
examples.tipBody: Dodge just after the boss finishes attacking to create a safe opening for a counterattack.
examples.warningBody: Open the chest before leaving the area. You cannot return after starting the next chapter.
examples.dangerBody: Confirming this choice locks your route. Create a manual save before continuing.
examples.stepsFirst: Defeat every enemy in the courtyard
examples.stepsSecond: Press the switch behind the statue
examples.stepsThird: Enter the treasure room through the open door
examples.spoilerBody: Collect every key before opening the final door to reach the **secret ending**.

nesting.title: Nesting blocks
nesting.description: Different advanced blocks can be nested. Keep each opening and closing marker on its own line so the structure stays clear.

spoilers.title: Whole-tip, block and inline spoilers
spoilers.description: Choose the smallest spoiler boundary that protects readers.
spoilers.whole: Use the publish form's spoiler switch when the entire tip gives away hidden information.
spoilers.block: Use a ::: spoiler block to hide multiple paragraphs or a list.
spoilers.inline: Use the inline syntax shown below for a short phrase within a sentence. Its text is obscured until clicked.
spoilers.inlineAfter: and the related trophy is awarded.

security.title: Safe content
security.description: Raw HTML and executable URLs are not accepted. Use Markdown links and the supported blocks instead.

lookup.heading: Look up a profile
lookup.hint: Enter a PSN ID to open that player's profile.

hero.title: Your PSN gaming assistant
hero.lead: PSRay organizes PlayStation trophy progress by player. Enter a PSN ID to review earned trophies, create your one-of-a-kind PSN profile page, and see recent play history in one place.

features.title: What PSRay Shows
features.lead: Profiles, trophy set details, leaderboards, and player tips give you a clearer view of any trophy collection.

profile.title: Player profiles
profile.description: Check trophy counts, level, global and regional ranks, a one-year activity calendar, platinum milestones, and trophies in unlock order.

trophies.title: Trophy set details
trophies.description: Browse trophies grouped by base game and DLC, with PSN and PSRay earn rates, rarity, hidden trophy controls, player-written tips, and fastest or first-completion rankings.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboards
leaderboard.description: Compare overall and regional trophy point rankings, and see which players contribute the most through tips and other community activity.

tips.title: Share trophy tips
tips.description: Each trophy can include notes from other players. Spoilers stay hidden until opened, useful tips collect votes, and contributors appear on the helpfulness leaderboard.
